name: dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.similarity
title: Catalog Similarity
description: Similarity anchors on Catalog Search and included substitutes and recommendations on Catalog Lookup. Extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search and dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.

like_item.title: Like Item
like_item.description: A similarity anchor. Carries exactly one anchor key: `id` for a product or variant, or `image` for an inline image when the Business advertises a non-zero `config.like.images.max_items`. Other extensions add anchor kinds by adding keys and SHOULD name them with reverse-domain keys (for example `com.example.color`) so independently authored kinds cannot collide. A Business MUST ignore items carrying no anchor key it recognizes.

id.description: Product or variant identifier in the Business's namespace. Resolution follows Catalog Lookup's Supported Identifiers: product ID and variant ID MUST be supported; secondary identifiers MAY be.

image.description: Inline image anchor. A Platform MUST NOT send image anchors unless the Business advertises a non-zero `config.like.images.max_items`.

content_type.description: MIME type of the encoded image, one of the types the Business advertises in `config.like.images.types`.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes; the string is at most `config.like.images.max_bytes` bytes long. Validators do not enforce the encoding; a Business drops an image anchor it cannot decode and reports it with an informational `image_invalid` message.

includes.title: Includes
includes.description: Optional data returned with a product when `include` names it.

substitutes.description: Functionally similar items a Buyer could purchase in place of the requested variant — the featured variant (`variants[0]`) in `get_product`, or the variants the request identifiers resolved to in `lookup_catalog` — as the Business determines, most suitable first. Each entry's `variants[]` is narrowed to the qualifying variant(s); another variant of this product MAY appear. Present only when `include` names `substitutes`; absent when unsupported; empty when none qualify.

recommendations.description: Related items the Business selects for this product, most relevant first — typically complementary. Present only when `include` names `recommendations`; absent when unsupported; empty when none qualify.

include.description: Optional data to include with each returned product. Well-known values: `substitutes` (functionally similar items purchasable in place of a variant), `recommendations` (related items the Business selects for a product). A Business MUST omit values it does not recognize or support and MUST return an empty array for a supported value with no results; presence means the Business understood the request.

similarity_lookup_product.description: A lookup product with included data. Used by lookup.

similarity_detail_product.description: A get_product detail product (carrying selected/options availability signals) with included data. Used by get_product.

like.description: Similarity anchors. Results are ranked by resemblance to the request's inputs (`query` and every anchor) as the Business determines it; this specification does not define the resemblance function. A product anchor excludes that product from results; a variant anchor excludes that variant only — its product MAY appear with other variants. An anchor that does not resolve contributes nothing (the Business SHOULD include an informational message: `not_found` for an identifier that does not resolve; `image_type_unsupported`, `image_too_large`, or `image_invalid` for an image anchor it cannot accept); if no anchor resolves, the result is empty. When a request carries more anchors than `config.like.max_items`, the Business processes the first `max_items` in request order and includes an informational `batch_limit_applied` message.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with similarity anchors (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with included data (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).
